findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure.
findings.comment: The employee restroom handwashing sink was observed to have no hot water available. The inspector instructed the operator to ensure hot water is provided at the restroom handwashing sink at all times. A follow-up (re-inspection) will be conducted on May 11, 2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 5-103.11(B) Capacity. (B) Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. [PF]

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment:
The following canned foods on the shelves were observed to have dents:
1. La costena refried beans has significant dent on the body.
2. Cheddar cheese sauce has significant dents on the body (x2).
3. Red enchilada sauce has significant dents on the body (x3).
4. Clover valley pinto beans has significant dents on the body and around the seam.
5. Premium cheddar has significant dent on the body.
6. Campbells spaghettios and meat balls has dents around the seam and significantly on the body.
7. County style baked beans has significant dent on the body.
8. Clover valley sliced carrots has significant dent on the body.

CORRECTED - The operator was informed and the dented cans were voluntarily removed from the shelf. Dented cans can have entry and harborage of Botulism, ensure canned foods with dents are removed from the shelves and not sold to customers.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. [PF]

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Light was observed to be passing through the right side of the over head door at the back storage. The inspector advised the operator to use weather strippings to seal the gap so as to prevent potential entry of pests.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following surfaces were observed to be in need of cleaning:

1. Under the shelled eggs tray in the third fresh food cooler was observed to have soil accumulation.
2. The bottom of the diary cooler at the back storage was observed to have soil accumulation.
3. The fan vents in the three fresh food coolers were observed to have dust accumulation. The dust accumulation on the fan vents in the second fresh food cooler are significant and almost covering the vents.
4. The nestle ice cream chest freezer was observed to have significant ice buildup.

The operator was instructed to have those surfaces clean. Ensure non-food contact surfaces are kept free of soil and dust accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure.
findings.comment: The employee restroom handwashing sink was observed to have no hot water available. The inspector instructed the operator to ensure hot water is provided at the restroom handwashing sink at all times. A follow-up (re-inspection) will be conducted on April 13, 2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 5-103.11(B) Capacity. (B) Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. [PF]

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: Dirty water from mopping was observed in two mop buckets by the mop sink. CORRECTED - The operator was informed and educated by the inspector and the mop buckets were voluntarily emptied. Dirty water from mopping the facility should be discarded when not actively in use.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW. [P]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: An opening was observed between the wall and handwashing sink in the employee restroom. The operator was instructed to have the opening caulked for smooth and easy cleaning and to prevent water from entering. The opening can also serve as a potential hideout for pests.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted. [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.19: FIRST REPEAT- The ice cream chest freezer was observed with a large accumulation of frost which prevents it from being smooth and easily cleanable. Ensure the frost is removed from the freezer and it is cleaned so it is smooth and easily cleanable. 

The back freezer in the storage area has a large accumulation of ice in the bottom of it. Ensure that this ice is removed to allow the bottom of the freezer to be smooth and easily cleanable. 

 NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.
